items.definition:
An additional feature or component
I installed a new addon for my web browser.

A chamber for passing between areas of different pressure
Astronauts enter and exit the spacecraft through an airlock.

Substance causing an allergic reaction
Pollen is a common allergen for many people.

A male news presenter
The anchorman delivered the evening news with a serious tone.

A small insect that feeds on plants
Aphids can cause significant damage to garden plants.

a portable rocket launcher
The soldier fired the bazooka at the tank.

a type of wild sheep with large, curved horns
We saw a bighorn sheep climbing the rocky mountain.

the number of bits per second that can be transmitted along a digital network
A higher bitrate usually means better audio quality.

a style of dress or decor inspired by bohemian culture
She loves to decorate her apartment in a boho style.

a view of a city
From the rooftop, we admired the stunning cityscape.

a person who cheats or tricks someone by means of a confidence trick
The conman tricked many people out of their savings.

a substance that is considered unpleasant or worthless
There was some sticky crud on the bottom of the shoe.

The range within which a voice can be heard.
Make sure you're within earshot if I call your name.

A short musical composition, typically for one instrument, designed as an exercise to improve technique.
She practiced the difficult piano etude for hours.

A truck or trailer with a flat, open body.
The construction materials were delivered on a flatbed truck.

A pincer-like instrument used in surgery or in the laboratory for grasping and holding.
The surgeon used forceps to remove the small object.

A grotesque carved human or animal face or figure projecting from the gutter of a building, typically acting as a spout to drain water.
The ancient cathedral was adorned with many stone gargoyles.

A lamp that burns gas for illumination.
The old house still had original gaslight fixtures.

A person whose knowledge, aptitudes, or skills are applied to a number of different fields.
She's a generalist, able to work on many different types of projects.

a mischievous invisible being, blamed for malfunctions
There must be a gremlin in the machine; it keeps breaking down.

space above one's head; space for maneuver
The car has plenty of headroom, even for tall passengers.

a jail or prison
He spent a night in the local jailhouse after the incident.

a unit of purity for gold alloys, or a unit of weight for gemstones
Her engagement ring was made of 18-karat gold.

an item kept in memory of the person who gave it or originally owned it
She kept the old locket as a keepsake from her grandmother.

small, shrimplike crustaceans that are a primary food source for whales
Whales consume vast amounts of krill every day.

the essential facts or information about something
Can you give me the lowdown on what happened at the meeting?

a heavy stone used for grinding grain; a heavy burden
The old debt became a millstone around his neck.

the basic monetary unit of Nigeria
The Nigerian naira has depreciated against the dollar.

The profession of examining eyes for defects and prescribing corrective lenses.
She decided to study optometry at university.

A segment of a film or recording that is removed from the final version.
The DVD included a reel of hilarious outtakes.

A light umbrella used to give shade from the sun.
She sat under a colorful parasol on the beach.

A light, loose undergarment hanging from the waist or shoulders.
She wore a long petticoat under her skirt.

A person or thing that is very impressive or talented.
The young athlete was a true phenom on the basketball court.

A person who devises a plot; a device for drawing graphs or plans.
The police arrested the plotter of the conspiracy.

A condition that must be fulfilled before other things can happen.
Good health is a precondition for a long life.

A person who searches for mineral deposits, especially gold.
The old prospector spent years searching for gold.

a person who walks for pleasure, especially in the countryside
He was a keen rambler, always exploring new trails.

the process of negotiating again
The contract required a renegotiation of terms after five years.

a person who uses satire
Jonathan Swift was a renowned satirist of his time.

an expert marksman
The sharpshooter hit the target from a great distance.

a black eye; a small, silvery fish
He got a shiner after bumping into the door.

a shallow, flat-bottomed open boat
They rowed the small skiff across the lake.

a detective
The amateur sleuth uncovered a crucial clue.

a sliding gate or other device for controlling the flow of water
The engineers opened the sluice to release the excess water from the dam.

the quality or state of being solid
The bridge's solidity was tested by the heavy traffic.

a barrier or enclosure formed from timber posts fixed in the ground
The prisoners were held in a temporary stockade before being transferred.

an uncertain belief
His theory was based on pure supposition, not on evidence.

a form of ownership or right to use a property for a specified period each year
They bought a timeshare in Florida for their annual family vacation.

a person who gives a tip; a truck or trailer that can be tilted to empty its contents
The construction site had several large tipper trucks delivering gravel.

the beginning of a trail
We met at the trailhead at 8 AM to start our hike.

a vigorous struggle or scuffle
The children had a playful tussle over the last cookie.

the action or process of wasting
The company implemented new policies to reduce material wastage.

extreme tiredness; fatigue
A deep weariness settled over him after the long journey.

the distance between the centers of the front and rear wheels of a vehicle
A longer wheelbase often contributes to a smoother ride in a car.

the quality of being acceptable
The acceptability of the new policy is still being debated.

the quality of being self-assured and confident
Her assertiveness helped her succeed in the negotiation.

the process of voting by ballot
The balloting process was conducted smoothly and fairly.

the part of a woman's dress that is above the waist
The dress had a fitted bodice and a flowing skirt.

a foolish or incompetent person
Don't be such a bozo and pay attention!

an ornamental pin; a tool for enlarging holes
She wore a beautiful silver broach on her lapel.

a close, non-sexual friendship between two men
Their bromance was evident in how they always supported each other.

a common rock-forming mineral
Calcite is the main component of limestone and marble.

the process of giving birth to children
The age of childbearing has increased in many countries.

a tree that bears cones and evergreen needles
Pine trees are a common type of conifer.
